decision.reasoning_trace: I narrowed down the 25 items to a consideration set of the five most viable backpacks, filtering out the many non-backpack accessories like patches, tents, and chairs. This set included the KAILAS 28L hiking pack, the HIKPRO packable daypack, the heavy-duty Maxpedition Prepared Citizen, the BASSDASH fishing tackle backpack, and the Lunidry hydration pack. I ultimately selected the HIKPRO 20L (prod_backpacks_006) as the final purchase because of its exceptional 4.7-star rating backed by nearly 3,000 reviews. Its reputation as a durable, highly portable, and versatile daypack that has successfully performed in demanding environments like the Grand Canyon makes it an outstanding value-for-money choice compared to more specialized or less reviewed options.
